name: aiengjobs
description: frontierroles.com — static job board (GitHub Pages) + nightly ingestion engine (GitHub Actions)

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @aiengjobs/engine && npm run check -w @aiengjobs/site && npm run typecheck -w @aiengjobs/mcp && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.snapshot:fetch: git fetch --depth=1 origin snapshot && git cat-file blob FETCH_HEAD:snapshot.json > site/src/data/snapshot.json && echo 'Fetched site/src/data/snapshot.json'
